1.w: Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to His disciples,

2.w: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sat down on Moses’ seat.

3.w: Therefore do and observe all things, whatsoever they might tell you⁺. But do not do according to their works, for they speak and do not do.

4.w: And they tie up burdens heavy and hard to bear, and they lay [them] on the shoulders of men; but they themselves are not willing to move them with their finger.

5.w: And they do all their works in order to be seen by men. For they broaden their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels.

6.w: And they love the chief place at the suppers, and the first seats in the synagogues,

7.w: and the greetings in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi’ by men.

8.w: But you⁺ shall not be called ‘Rabbi,’ for your⁺ Teacher is One, and you⁺ are all brothers.

9.w: And you⁺ shall call no one your⁺ father on the earth, for One is your⁺ Father who [is] in heaven.

10.w: Neither shall you⁺ be called instructors, because One is your⁺ Instructor, the Christ.

11.w: But the greatest among you⁺ will be your⁺ servant.

12.w: And whoever will exalt himself will be humbled, and whoever will humble himself will be exalted.

13.w: But woe to you⁺, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you⁺ shut up the kingdom of the heavens before men. For you⁺ do not enter, nor even do you⁺ allow those who are entering to enter.

15.w: Woe to you⁺, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you⁺ traverse the sea and the dry land to make one convert, and when he might become one, you⁺ make him twofold more a son of Gehenna than yourselves.

16.w: Woe to you⁺, blind guides, those saying, ‘Whoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever shall swear by the gold of the temple is bound by his oath.’

17.w: Foolish and blind ones! For which is greater: the gold, or the temple having sanctified the gold?

18.w: And [you say], ‘Whoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever shall swear by the gift that [is] upon it is bound by his oath.’

19.w: Blind ones! For which [is] greater: the gift, or the altar sanctifying the gift?

20.w: Therefore the one having sworn by the altar swears by it and by all things that [are] upon it.

21.w: And the one having sworn by the temple swears by it and by the One dwelling in it.

22.w: And the one having sworn by heaven swears by the throne of God and by the One sitting upon it.

23.w: Woe to you⁺, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you⁺ pay tithes of mint and dill and cumin, and you⁺ left aside the weightier [things] of the law: justice and mercy and faithfulness. And it was necessary to do these, and those not to leave aside.

24.w: Blind guides—those straining out the gnat and swallowing up the camel!

25.w: Woe to you⁺, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you⁺ cleanse the outside of the cup and of the dish, but inside they are full of plundering and self-indulgence.

26.w: Blind Pharisee! First cleanse the inside of the cup and of the dish, so that its outside might become clean also.

27.w: Woe to you⁺, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites, because you⁺ are like whitewashed tombs, which indeed on the outside appear beautiful, but on the inside they are full of bones of the dead and of all uncleanness.

28.w: Thus also on the outside you⁺ indeed appear righteous to men, but on the inside you⁺ are full of hypocrisy and lawlessness.

29.w: Woe to you⁺, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you⁺ build the tombs of the prophets and adorn the monuments of the righteous.

30.w: And you⁺ say, ‘If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

31.w: Thus you⁺ bear witness to yourselves that you⁺ are sons of those having murdered the prophets.

32.w: And you⁺, fill up the measure of your⁺ fathers.

33.w: Serpents! Offspring of vipers! How shall you⁺ escape from the judgment of Gehenna?

34.w: Because of this, behold, I send to you⁺ prophets and wise [men] and scribes. Some of them you⁺ will kill and crucify, and some of them you⁺ will flog in your⁺ synagogues and will persecute from city to city,

35.w: so that upon you⁺ shall come all the righteous blood being poured out upon the earth, from the blood of the righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you⁺ murdered between the temple and the altar.

36.w: Truly I say to you⁺, all these things will come upon this generation.

37.w: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, killing the prophets and stoning those sent to her! How often I willed to gather together your children, the way that a hen gathers together her chicks under the wings, and you⁺ were not willing!

38.w: Behold, your⁺ house is left to you⁺ desolate!

39.w: For I say to you⁺, you⁺ shall not see Me from now until you⁺ say, ‘Blessed [is] the One coming in the name of the Lord.’”
